declarations.description:
AuroButton is a custom element that provides a styled, accessible button with support for various states and form association.
It is designed to be flexible, supporting loading states, icon slots, and integration with HTML5 forms.
declarations.name: AuroButton

members.name: _renderTag
members.description: Renders the tag for the component.

members.name: appearance
members.description: Defines whether the button will be on lighter or darker backgrounds.

members.name: attributeWatcher
members.description: return object from transportAttributes via a11yUtilities

members.name: autofocus
members.description: This Boolean attribute lets you specify that the button should have input focus when the page loads, unless overridden by the user.

members.name: currentAriaLabel
members.description: Returns the current value of the projected `aria-label` attribute or undefined if not set. The `aria-label` attribute is for internal use only.

members.name: currentAriaLabelledBy
members.description: Returns the current value of the projected `aria-labelledby` attribute or undefined if not set.

members.name: disabled
members.description: If set to true, button will become disabled and not allow for interactions.

members.name: fluid
members.description: Alters the shape of the button to be full width of its parent container.

members.name: focus
members.description: Internal method to apply focus to the HTML5 button.

members.name: form
members.description: Returns the form element that this button is associated with.

members.name: formAssociated
members.description: Enables form association for this element.

members.name: generateAriaLabel
members.description: Returns the appropriate string to be used for the aria-label attribute.

members.name: getFontSize
members.description: Gets a class name for the font size based on the button's size and shape.

members.name: iconOnly
members.description: Whether or not the button is set to an icon-only shape.

members.name: layout
members.description: Override layout since it isn't used in this component.

members.name: loading
members.description: If set to true button text will be replaced with `auro-loader` and become disabled.

members.name: loadingText
members.description: DEPRECATED - Use `slot="ariaLabel.loading"` instead.

members.name: onDark
members.description: DEPRECATED - use `appearance` attribute.

members.name: onPointerEvent
members.description:
This is to detect pointer events for hover and active states for styling purposes.
:host with :has selector dont work together in Safari and Firefox

members.name: register

parameters.name: name
parameters.description: The name of the element that you want to register.

members.description: This will register this element with the browser.

members.name: renderLayout
members.description: Renders the layout of the button.

members.name: renderLayoutDefault
members.description: Renders the default layout for the button.

members.name: shape
members.description: Defines the shape of an element.

members.name: size
members.description: Defines the size of an element.

members.name: static
members.description: If true, the button will be static and not respond to user interactions.

members.name: surfaceSubmitEvent
members.description: Submits the form that this button is associated with.

members.name: tabindex
members.description:
Populates `tabindex` to define the focusable sequence in keyboard navigation.
Must be used with "." to ensure the host element does not retain a reference to the `tabindex` attribute.
Example: `<auro-button .tabindex="${this.disabled ? '-1' : '0'}"></auro-button>`.

members.name: tIndex
members.description: Populates `tabindex` to define the focusable sequence in keyboard navigation.

members.name: title
members.description: Sets title attribute. The information is most often shown as a tooltip text when the mouse moves over the element.

members.name: value
members.description: Defines the value associated with the button which is submitted with the form data.

members.name: wrapper
members.description:
A reference to the wrapper element in the shadow DOM.
This is used to apply layout and shape classes dynamically.

declarations.name: transportAttributes

type.text:
@param {HTMLElement} params.host - The host element from which attributes will be transported.
 * @param {HTMLElement} params.target - The target element to which attributes will be transported.
 * @param {boolean} [params.removeOriginal=true] - Whether to remove the attributes from the host element.
 * @param {boolean} [params.observe=true] - Whether to attach a MutationObserver to the host element.
 *

declarations.description: Transfers all matching attributes from a host element to a target element and observes for future changes.
